en.quote: I think I have already told you that I have never changed the Constitution. I have no such plans today [to change the Constitution].
en.head: A constitutional amendment reset the term count.
en.body: Constitutional amendments adopted in 2020 allowed Putin’s previous presidential terms to be disregarded for future candidacies. In the 2018 interview he said he had no plans to change the Constitution at that time; his position subsequently changed.
